basis: Neoplasm arising in extrahepatic bile ducts, which belong to the hepatic axis.
Neonatal platelet deficiency; transient duration does not change its haematologic location.
Inherited skin blistering, scarring and nail dystrophy; ocular and oral abnormalities occur in only 5-29%.
Monoclonal plasma-cell disorder with defining renal light-chain deposition; clinically significant cardiac and hepatic involvement is rare.
Localized amyloid deposition produces dermal and subcutaneous nodules; associated connective-tissue diseases are separate conditions.
Intestinal nematode infection; adult worms occupy the gastrointestinal tract.
HPV-associated recurrent airway papillomas; scarring atrophodermia vermiculata and keratosis pilaris reported in 2/2 patients.
Muscular dystrophy with defining brain and eye anomalies; intellectual disability in 7/8 and cataract in 3/8.
Defined by developmental delay, intellectual disability and neurologic hypotonia; dysmorphism does not establish another damaged organ.
Methionine metabolism disorder; definition specifies hepatomegaly and elevated enzymes without liver disease. Neurologic problems are a conditional risk.
Benign adipose neoplasm arising in an extrahepatic bile duct; location determines the axis.
Conductive hearing impairment in 1/3 assessed patients (~33%; small sample). Cerebral visual impairment is neurologic; reflux and infections do not establish direct organ damage.
Inherited vitreoretinal disease; hearing and neurodevelopmental involvement vary by subtype and are not established at >=30% across this umbrella.
Epilepsy with developmental impairment and encephalopathy defines a brain disorder.
Defining hair dysplasia/alopecia and defective dental enamel; both occur in 80-99%.
Localized loss of papillary dermal elastic fibers; definition explicitly states no systemic involvement.
Respiratory ciliary dysfunction; chronic middle-ear dysfunction/hearing loss affects >30% in primary ciliary dyskinesia, though CFAP46-specific frequency is uncertain.
Skeletal dysplasia defined by abnormal bone growth, joint laxity and progressive spinal malalignment; no additional organ is established across subtypes.
Inherited tooth-enamel hypoplasia; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Progressive skeletal muscular dystrophy; dysphagia reflects muscle weakness. Definition specifies absent cardiac and respiratory symptoms.
Pituitary growth-hormone deficiency; proportionate short stature does not establish a separate skeletal disorder.
Microcornea, retinal dystrophy, cataract and posterior staphyloma all affect the eye.
Pancreatic carcinoma with defining exocrine and endocrine components; metastatic sites are unspecified.
Neurodevelopmental disorder with language and motor delay; ocular, skeletal and skin abnormalities individually occur in only 1/4 patients.
Neurologic thermoregulatory disorder; episodic arrhythmia, sweating and gastrointestinal symptoms do not establish lasting damage to other organs.
